digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow and plan review modules
propositions: Nine modules in the codebase are at or within 20 lines of the 800-LOC hard cap, blocking legitimate feature work from landing

gate_dispatch.py has exactly 1 line of headroom and contains three of five call sites for finalize_verdict, making it physically impossible to add the provider_provenance parameter threading required by story 343b without exceeding the cap
The 800-LOC cap is now degrading documentation quality and design decisions; explanatory comments and natural helper placement are being sacrificed purely to save lines
The saturated module set must be split along existing call-graph seams using the proven precedent from tasks 2682 and 3a98 (zero test edits, re-imports to preserve external interfaces)
After splitting gate_dispatch.py and orchestrator.py, both modules must be under 700 LOC with at least 100 lines of headroom remaining, and no extracted module may fall below 100 LOC
